candidates.explanation: For FileDriver.LOCAL, the transform builds the file URL with appConfig().frontendDomain instead of appConfig().backendDomain. Local files are served by the backend, so serialized photo paths (e.g. in /auth/me) point at the frontend host and fail to load.

fix.description: Use backendDomain instead of frontendDomain in the LOCAL branch of the transform.
